response.sql:
WITH qualifying_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE `U-PRO` = '-' AND RA = '-'
),
patient_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    ID,
    AVG(PT) as pt_avg,
    AVG(TAT - TAT2) as tat_diff_avg
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM qualifying_patients)
  GROUP BY ID
)
SELECT 
  AVG(pt_avg) as avg_pt,
  AVG(tat_diff_avg) as avg_tat_diff
FROM patient_averages;

assumptions.assumption: Both U-PRO = '-' and RA = '-' must appear in the same laboratory record for a patient to qualify. The phrase 'laboratory results include' is interpreted as a single examination record.

alternatives.interpretation: The patient must have at least one record with U-PRO = '-' and (separately, in possibly different records) at least one record with RA = '-'. The phrase 'laboratory results' refers to the collection of all examinations across all dates for a patient.
alternatives.sql:
WITH qualifying_patients AS (
  SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE `U-PRO` = '-'
  INTERSECT
  SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE RA = '-'
),
patient_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    ID,
    AVG(PT) as pt_avg,
    AVG(TAT - TAT2) as tat_diff_avg
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM qualifying_patients)
  GROUP BY ID
)
SELECT 
  AVG(pt_avg) as avg_pt,
  AVG(tat_diff_avg) as avg_tat_diff
FROM patient_averages;
